title: The Elegant handwriting on the page
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：elegant　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 elegant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the shopkeeper wrote of ① an elegant handwriting on the page in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more elegant than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the elegant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most elegant handwriting on the page anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the account for July 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too elegant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the elegant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an elegant solution to the problem, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as elegant as the solution to the problem they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was elegant or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something elegant, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite elegant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the elegant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another elegant handwriting on the page in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more elegant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most elegant solution to the problem in the whole shop, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the elegant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 优雅（前置定语 an elegant handwriting on the page：1974 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件优雅的字迹）
B. adj. 优雅／雅致（比较级 more elegant than：文中两处，一处比纸上的字迹，一处比预想）
C. adj. 优雅／雅致（最高级 the most elegant：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 优雅（表语 too elegant to do：母亲觉得它太优雅，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 雅致（前置定语 an elegant solution to the problem：叔叔把整件事称作一桩雅致的解题法）
F. adj. 雅致（同级比较 as elegant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩漂亮的解题法相比）
G. adj. 雅致（后置定语 something elegant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 雅致（受程度副词修饰 quite elegant：那位买主的评价）

items.q: an elegant handwriting on the page
the most elegant handwriting on the page anybody
an elegant solution to the problem
The most elegant solution to the problem in

answers.why: elegant 意为“优雅”，1974 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件优雅的字迹”，此处作前置定语 an elegant handwriting on the page。
elegant 意为“优雅”，此处用比较级 more elegant than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
elegant 意为“优雅”，账本上 七月 那行字说它是铺子里最优雅的一件，故用最高级 the most elegant handwriting on the page。
elegant 意为“优雅”，母亲认为这件东西“太优雅了，谁也用不上”，too elegant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
elegant 意为“雅致”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩雅致的解题法”，此处作前置定语 an elegant solution to the problem。
elegant 意为“雅致”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩漂亮的解题法一样雅致”，同级比较用 as elegant as。
elegant 意为“雅致”，账本上那半行字要的是“雅致的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something elegant。
elegant 意为“雅致”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当雅致”，quite 修饰原级 elegant。
elegant 意为“雅致”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要雅致”，故用比较级 more elegant than。
elegant 意为“雅致”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个铺子里最雅致的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most elegant solution to the problem。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件优雅的字迹。（an elegant handwriting on the page）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更优雅。（more elegant than …）
母亲觉得它太优雅，谁也用不上。（too elegant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩雅致的解题法。（an elegant solution to the problem）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩漂亮的解题法一样雅致。（as elegant as …）
到了 1981 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件雅致的东西。（something elegant）
answers: In 1974 the shopkeeper wrote of an elegant handwriting on the page in the account.
Everybody said it was more elegant than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too elegant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an elegant solution to the problem.
He said nobody would call it as elegant as the solution to the problem they had once had.
By 1981 the account asked for nothing but something elegant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 elegant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the shopkeeper wrote of an elegant handwriting on the page in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most elegant handwriting on the page in the shop, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too elegant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an elegant solution to the problem, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite elegant, and everybody laughed.
The elegant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
